name: Hoplomachus
description: A defensive certamen style named for warriors armored like Greek hoplites; it trades attack and initiative for greatly increased Defense.

name: Laquerius
description: The certamen School of the Noose, whose practitioners bind the opponent's ritual working and impose lasting Defense penalties.

name: Provocator
description: The certamen School of Challengers, which sacrifices Initiative for a higher Resistance Total; its members are social, organized and flippant in duels.

name: Pumilius
description: The certamen School of the (Amusing) Dwarfs, which projects humorous images into the shared illusion to make opponents lose an attack or defense; some Tremere find it offensive.

name: Retiarius
description: The certamen School of the Fisherman, which strikes swiftly, gains Initiative bonuses and evades damage.

name: Saggitarius
description: The Technique of the Archer, a certamen style introduced by a Merinita magus to humiliate a Tremere rival; it adds heavily to Attack but can do only one Fatigue level of damage, and many Tremere dispute its legitimacy.

name: Scissor
description: The certamen School of Carvers, which skips an attack to deliver a crippling deep attack in the following round.

name: Velitus
description: The certamen Style of the Spear, which wears down an opponent's magical resistance, potentially making their Resistance Total negative.

name: Certamen
description: Formalized magical dueling in the Order of Hermes, fought through a shared illusion; accepted as decisive in all disputes at the 817 Grand Tribunal.

name: Certamen Schools
description: Distinct styles of certamen practiced mainly by Tremere magi, each with its own Finesse-based tricks; Harenarii pioneer most new schools.

name: Finesse
description: Ability whose score governs the bonuses of certamen styles and rolls such as drawing legible diagrams magically.

name: Parma Magica
description: The Hermetic magic resistance ritual developed by Bonisagus in the Cave; raising it purges a possessing ghost.

name: House Tremere
description: A Hermetic House that practices certamen styles, uses ghosts, recruits dhampirs, and has specialists such as Architects, Assessors and Leadworkers.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House; a Merinita magus introduced the saggitarius certamen technique to humiliate a Tremere rival.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House of the Redcaps, founded by Mercere, whose domus magna is Harco.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House descended from Guernicus; its Primi include Fenicil and Bilera, and Simprim began its Transitionalist movement.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House of Bonisagus; Murion was selected as its Prima in 1213.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi formed by the Twelve Founders at Durenmar in 767.

name: Venomous Velites
description: Creo Animal level 45 spell (Rego requisite) creating a swarm of a hundred poisonous scorpions the caster can command against specific targets.

name: To See as Others See
description: Intellego Animal level 40 spell (Rego requisite) letting a magus read an animal's thoughts and direct it as a spy, perceiving through its mind.

name: The Unfaithful Favor
description: Rego Animal level 45 spell commanding a silk handkerchief to strangle an enemy for whom the magus has an arcane connection.

name: Exactly to Scale
description: Rego Aquam level 10 spell (Mentem requisite) designed by a Tremere Artificer to draw precise pictures of a magus's ideas in ink, used for diagrams and mapmaking.

name: To Mark with Umbrage
description: Creo Imaginem level 30 spell marking up to a thousand people with the caster's sigil so friend can be told from foe in battle; a level 25 Voice version affects about ten.

name: False Prophecy
description: Muto Mentem level 30 spell that alters a victim's memories of dreams into a persistent crafted nightmare meant to influence decisions.

name: Swords of Silver and Moonlight
description: Muto Mentem level 40 spell (Terram requisite) making a ghost's metal accouterments solid so it can use its entire kit.

name: Spectral Quinreme
description: Muto Mentem level 50 spell (Herbam requisite) making a spectral ghost ship solid enough to sail upon and carry cargo.

name: Arming the Legion of the Dead
description: Muto Mentem level 70 Ritual (Terram requisite) making the metal gear of up to 10,000 ghosts solid, without granting control over them.

name: Voices from Hollow Spaces
description: Rego Mentem level 25 spell binding ghosts to objects or places such as mirrors, skulls and graves.

name: The Face in the Mirror
description: Rego Mentem level 40 spell forcing a ghost to possess a magus while the magus retains control, used by Tremere Assessors.

name: Call the Fallen Eagles from the Mist
description: Rego Mentem level 65 Ritual used on ancient battlefields to summon and control up to 10,000 pagan dead.

name: A Simple Method for Rapid Vallation
description: Creo Terram level 35 spell creating a crenellated granite wall up to 500 paces wide; a botch during the Corruption of Tytalus put the walkway on the enemy side.

name: Love's Unfaithful Witness
description: Intellego Terram level 35 spell to question jewelry about its wearer's activities, its personality shaped by its largest gemstone.

name: A Window of Singular Direction
description: Muto Terram level 15 spell by the Architects of Tremere making a circle of wall transparent from one side.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: Spell (ArM5 p.146) referenced as the model for the invisibility power granted by Zmey mythic blood.

name: Wings of the Soaring Wind
description: Spell (ArM5 p.126) referenced as the model for the Zmey-blood power to fly on the wind.

name: Shape of the Woodland Prowler
description: Spell (ArM5 p.131) referenced as the model for the Zmey-blood power to turn into a dog or bear.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique of creation, used in spells such as Venomous Velites and A Simple Method for Rapid Vallation.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique of perception, used in To See as Others See and Love's Unfaithful Witness.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique of transformation, used in False Prophecy and ghost-arming spells.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique of control, used in The Unfaithful Favor and ghost-binding spells.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form governing animals.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form governing water and liquids such as ink.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form governing images and sensory species.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form governing minds and ghosts.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form governing earth, stone and metal.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form governing plants and wood, a requisite for Spectral Quinreme.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form governing human bodies; amber grants a Corpus bonus.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A magical link to a target that enables Arcane-range spells; Leadworkers can fix arcane connections in kolossoi.

name: Ritual
description: Ritual spells such as Arming the Legion of the Dead and Call the Fallen Eagles from the Mist.

name: Shape and Material Bonus
description: Bonus table for enchanting, expanded here with amber, human skull, lead, mirror, opal and rhodocrosite.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical substance; Leadworkers can make fixed arcane connections without spending vis.

name: Ghost
description: Spirits of the dead tied to Earth by unfinished business, which Tremere magi bind, arm, command and bargain with.

name: Ghost Ship
description: A spectral ship projected by the psyche of a ghost, like its clothes or weapons, which can be made solid with Mentem magic.

name: Grogs
description: Mundane soldiers and servants of magi; shield grogs and grogs wearing covenant badges are mentioned.

name: Tremere Artificer
description: A Tremere specialist role; one designed the spell Exactly to Scale.

name: Tremere Architect
description: Tremere magi specializing in fortification magic, creators of A Window of Singular Direction.

name: Tremere Assessor
description: Tremere magi who use The Face in the Mirror briefly for urgent tasks in cities.

name: Leadworker
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue descended from Aita cult necromancy, enabling crafting of katadesmoi and kolossoi containing fixed arcane connections; Leadworkers also supply Tremere magi with ghosts.

name: Katadesmos
description: A curse tablet, usually lead or a mirror's back, used to curse and control the individual named upon it; +2 penetration.

name: Kolossos
description: A figurine used as a curse representation; with an embedded sympathetic connection from the victim's body it grants +3 penetration.

name: Aita cult
description: Ancient necromantic cult whose style of necromancy is the source of Leadworking.

name: Dhampir
description: Major Supernatural Virtue: a half-vampire child with slowed aging, Second Sight and darkvision; Tremere recruit dhampirs as guards but forbid training them as Hermetic magi.

name: Vampire
description: A type of dark faerie found in the Transylvania Tribunal that returns from the grave, fathers dhampirs, and has varied vulnerabilities such as crossroads and church bells.

name: Dark Faerie
description: Faeries of a dark kind, including vampires, not strictly infernal spirits, with widely varying vulnerabilities.

name: Second Sight
description: Virtue (ArM5 p.48) possessed by dhampirs, letting them see invisible beings.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Lore Ability that dhampirs may learn at character generation with a +1 bonus.

name: The Gift
description: The inborn capacity for magic; dhampirs may have it, and Mercere lost his in 773.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw applicable to a dhampir trained as a Hermetic magus against House Tremere's prohibition.

name: Hedge wizard
description: Non-Hermetic wizards; hedge wizard dhampirs are permitted as Tremere servants.

name: Folk Dancer
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: members of a troupe of a dozen or more who perform pagan dances creating minor magical effects such as a harvest blessing reducing storms.

name: Carouse
description: Ability used with Dexterity by folk dancers to perform magical dances.

name: Samovily Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Faerie Blood bonuses plus one bonus (archery, riding, music, Presence or underwater) from descent from samovily.

name: Samovily
description: Bulgarian mystical maidens, mostly faeries (one infernal), including woodland archers who ride deer, water and air spirits, and breath-stealing ghosts of brides.

name: Wili
description: Breath-sucking ghostly maidens referenced as similar to one type of samovily.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Virtue whose usual bonuses are gained by characters with Samovily Blood.

name: Mythic Blood (Zmey)
description: Major Hermetic Virtue from descent from a zmey, granting a Minor Magical Focus with Storms and an innate power of invisibility, flight, or shapechange.

name: Zmey
description: A variety of dragon native to the Transylvania Tribunal that guards villages against evil spirits, flies, shapeshifts and charms young women; females are zmeyitsas.

name: Magical Focus
description: Virtue type; Zmey blood grants a Minor Magical Focus with Storms.

name: Lecherous
description: Minor Personality Flaw typical of zmey descendants.

name: Meddler
description: Minor Personality Flaw typical of zmey descendants.

name: Proud
description: Minor Personality Flaw typical of zmey descendants.

name: Harenarius
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue, a 'Person of the Sand' able to master two Certamen Schools, starting with Reputation 2 as a master duelist among Tremere.

name: Nyktophylax
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue: 'night guards' whose Sun-duration magic fails at noon and midnight, named from sentry duty in the Schism War.

name: Transylvania Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal where vampires that father dhampirs and zmey are found.

name: Thebes Tribunal
description: Regional Tribunal where Bonisagus was last seen alive in 836.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The Order-wide Tribunal, constituted in 773, first met in 799, set on a 33-year schedule in 832.

name: First Tribunal
description: The original gathering of the Founders at Durenmar in 767, which formed the Order; its second meeting was 773.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder born in Florence in 690 who developed the Parma Magica in the Cave; Marched his filius Jovius and was last seen in 836.

name: Trianoma
description: Founder born in Thessaly in 705, apprentice of Bonisagus, who recruited Mercere, Guernicus and others to form the Order; died after the 832 Grand Tribunal.

name: Guernicus
description: Founder born 714, apprenticed as a Mercurian earth wizard, who sought justice for his murdered master.

name: Viea
description: Met Bonisagus at the Cave with Trianoma in 731 but soon departed.

name: Notatus
description: Accepted as Bonisagus's second apprentice in 732.

name: Mercere
description: Founder, the first magus to accept Trianoma's invitation; lost his Gift in 773, helped bring Redcaps into the Order and died in 818.

name: Guorna the Fetid
description: Met by Trianoma in 757.

name: Twelve Founders
description: The founders who formed the Order of Hermes at Durenmar in 767.

name: Jovius
description: Filius of Bonisagus whom Bonisagus was forced to March in 812.

name: Fenicil
description: Primus of House Guernicus from 832 who declared in 875 that the Order's tradition reaches to the beginnings of history.

name: Tremere
description: Founder of the Order and the last founder to die, in 862.

name: Belin
description: Magus of House Mercere who died in 887.

name: Golias
description: Magus of House Mercere cast out of the Order in 961.

name: Insatella
description: Became Prima of House Mercere in 1141.

name: Simprim
description: Started the Transitionalist movement within House Guernicus in 1148.

name: Murion
description: Selected as Prima of House Bonisagus in 1213.

name: Umno
description: Tremere Primus who retired in 1218 to lead the Burning Acorns Vexillation.

name: Poena
description: Became Prima of House Tremere in 1218 and began a series of research covenants.

name: Bilera
description: Elected Guernicus Prima in 1218.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers brought into the Order in 817 at the urging of Mercere and Trianoma.

name: Mercurian rituals
description: Rituals discovered by Bonisagus in an abandoned well in 717; Guernicus was apprenticed as a Mercurian earth wizard.

name: The Cave
description: Where Bonisagus retreated in 720 to develop the Parma Magica and met Trianoma and Viea.

name: Durenmar
description: Where the Twelve Founders gathered in 767 to form the Order of Hermes.

name: Harco
description: Domus magna of House Mercere, founded 770.

name: Magvillus
description: Domus magna of House Guernicus, whose inner council summoned thirty magi for the Curse of Thoth in 1011.

name: Curse of Thoth
description: Ritual performed in 1011 by thirty Guernicus magi summoned to Magvillus.

name: Schism War
description: Hermetic war of 1003-1017 during which Nyktophylaxes served as sentries.

name: Sundering of House Tremere
description: Event in 848 in the history of House Tremere.

name: Corruption of Tytalus
description: Historical episode during which a Tremere magus botched A Simple Method for Rapid Vallation.

name: Duresca scrolls
description: Scrolls discovered in 937.

name: Transitionalist movement
description: Movement within House Guernicus started by Simprim in 1148.

name: Burning Acorns Vexillation
description: Tremere vexillation led by retired Primus Umno from 1218.

name: Tremere Decennial
description: Periodic Tremere gathering; the most recent was in 1218.

name: Tiranova rebellion
description: Rebellion of 1185 that led to independence for the Bulgarians.

name: Sack of Constantinople
description: The 1204 sack of Constantinople.

name: Constantinople
description: City whose general blinded a Bulgarian army in 1014, sacked in 1204.

name: Florence
description: Birthplace of Bonisagus in 690.

name: Thessaly
description: Birthplace of Trianoma in 705.

name: Rome
description: City cited as an example of what Roman legionnaire ghosts might refuse to attack.

name: Domus magna
description: The chief covenant of a Hermetic House, e.g. Harco and Magvillus.

name: March
description: Hermetic sentence of death and outlawry; Bonisagus was forced to March his filius Jovius.
